cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says ten or more government services can be completed online, or that one national portal carries several ministries' services with one sign-in. No count of users or transactions has been found; the national e-Gouv portal is still being tendered.
cells.note: The Burundi Revenue Office requires the 2026/2027 land tax declaration to be filed online on UMUTANGAKORI II (BDI-002, July 2026), a service applied for online: yes to question 1. No count of ten or more services is found, so it stops at 2.
